Name: Hold to Water
Author: Zholohs
Description:
[size=5][b]Hold to Water[/b][/size]

Tired of stopping for every single pour? [b]Hold to Water[/b] lets you water your crops in one smooth pass. Just hold the use-tool button and walk down your rows. Every dry tile you pass gets watered without breaking stride.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Hold and walk to water.[/b] No swing, no charge-up, no freeze. Keep moving while you water.[/*]
[*][b]Only uses water where it's needed.[/b] Tiles that are already watered (or aren't soil) cost nothing, so your can lasts longer.[/*]
[*][b]Your farmer carries the can.[/b] While you hold the button, your farmer walks with the tipped watering can and a stream of water, using the game's own watering can sprites, facing the right way in every direction.[/*]
[*][b]Works with every watering can.[/b] Basic, Copper, Steel, Gold and Iridium each show their own art, and modded cans that use the vanilla tool sheet layout work automatically.[/*]
[*][b]Upgrades still matter.[/b] The watered area grows with your can: 1x1 (Basic/Copper), 3x3 (Steel/Gold), 5x5 (Iridium), and it keeps scaling for cans upgraded past Iridium by other mods.[/*]
[*][b]Garden pots supported.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Respects enchantments.[/b] Bottomless never runs dry, and Efficient makes watering free.[/*]
[*][b]Fair energy cost.[/b] Each tile watered costs the same energy as one vanilla basic-can swing, and it stops before you'd pass out.[/*]
[*][b]Refilling is unchanged.[/b] Tap on water (or the pet bowl) to refill like normal.[/*]
[*]Works with mouse, keyboard and controller.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Every option can be changed in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional), or in [i]config.json[/i] after the first launch.
[list]
[*][b]Target tile[/b]: Cursor (the tile under your mouse if it's next to you, otherwise the tile in front of you), Facing (always in front), or Underfoot.[/*]
[*][b]Area[/b]: grows with upgrades, or always a single tile.[/*]
[*][b]Skip empty soil[/b]: only water tilled soil that has a crop.[/*]
[*][b]Use energy / Energy multiplier[/b]: turn the energy cost off or scale it.[/*]
[*][b]Show can while walking, Show splash, Play sound[/b]: cosmetic toggles.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.[/*]
[*]Tested alongside Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and Stardew RPG.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: each player who wants the feature needs the mod installed. Watered soil syncs normally.[/*]
[*]Mods that replace the watering can's tool animation may conflict visually.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Made by Zholohs.
